blocks.zh: 包裝完整性測試：測試方法選擇與驗證 完整教學版
blocks.en: Package Integrity Testing: Test Method Selection and Validation (Complete Tutorial Edition)

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標 Learning Objectives
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 理解容器密封完整性 (CCI) 測試在藥品生命週期三個階段的角色與要求
blocks.en: Understand the role and requirements of container closure integrity (CCI) testing across the three stages of the drug product life cycle

blocks.zh: 掌握 12 項測試方法選擇標準，能針對特定產品-包裝系統做出合理選擇
blocks.en: Master the 12 test method selection criteria and make a sound selection for a specific product-package system

blocks.zh: 區分確定性 (Deterministic) 與機率性 (Probabilistic) 洩漏測試方法的本質差異
blocks.en: Distinguish the fundamental difference between deterministic and probabilistic leak test methods

blocks.zh: 了解方法開發與驗證的八大要素：準確性、精密性、專一性、偵測限、定量限、線性、範圍、穩健性
blocks.en: Understand the eight elements of method development and validation: accuracy, precision, specificity, detection limit, quantitation limit, linearity, range, and robustness

blocks.zh: 能設計陰性對照品與陽性對照品，並理解缺陷製作方法
blocks.en: Be able to design negative and positive controls, and understand how defects are created

blocks.zh: 理解 FDA 2008 穩定性指引中以 CCI 測試取代無菌試驗的科學依據
blocks.en: Understand the scientific rationale in the 2008 FDA stability guidance for replacing sterility testing with CCI testing

blocks.zh: Section 1 — Introduction 導論
blocks.en: Section 1 — Introduction

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts
blocks.en: Key Concepts

blocks.zh: USP〈1207〉系列包含三個子章節：〈1207.1〉方法選擇、〈1207.2〉洩漏技術、〈1207.3〉密封品質技術。這三章合在一起構成 USP 對 CCI（Container Closure Integrity）的完整指引。
blocks.en: The USP <1207> series consists of three sub-chapters: <1207.1> Test Method Selection, <1207.2> Leak Technologies, and <1207.3> Seal Quality Technologies. Together, these three chapters form USP's complete guidance on CCI (container closure integrity).

blocks.zh: 本章的核心訴求：包裝完整性驗證必須貫穿產品整個生命週期，而非僅在上市前完成一次。
blocks.en: The central message of this chapter: package integrity must be demonstrated throughout the entire product life cycle, not just once before launch.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: 想像你買了一輛新車。CCI 測試就像汽車的防水測試：不只是出廠時測一次，而是在設計階段（研發）、生產線上（製造）、以及長時間存放後（穩定性）都要確認「密封無虞」。藥品包裝也是同樣邏輯。
blocks.en: Imagine you have bought a new car. CCI testing is like a waterproofing test for the car: it is not done just once at the factory, but at the design stage (development), on the production line (manufacturing), and again after long-term storage (stability) to confirm that the seal is still intact. Drug product packaging follows the same logic.

blocks.zh: Section 2 — Package Integrity Testing in the Product Life Cycle 產品生命週期中的包裝完整性測試
blocks.en: Section 2 — Package Integrity Testing in the Product Life Cycle

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析：產品-包裝概況 (Product-Package Profile)
blocks.en: Key Concepts: Product-Package Profile

blocks.zh: 開發階段的關鍵輸出是「使用者需求規格書 (URS)」，必須涵蓋：
blocks.en: The key output of the development stage is the user requirements specification (URS), which must cover:

blocks.zh: 產品用途與穩定性需求
blocks.en: Intended use of the product and stability requirements

blocks.zh: 預期的儲存、運輸、配送環境
blocks.en: Expected storage, transport, and distribution environments

blocks.zh: 最大允許洩漏限度 (MALL)——這是整個 CCI 策略的核心數字
blocks.en: Maximum allowable leakage limit (MALL): the central number of the entire CCI strategy

blocks.zh: 關鍵物理屬性與尺寸公差
blocks.en: Critical physical attributes and dimensional tolerances

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes
blocks.en: Key Notes

blocks.zh: 固有包裝完整性 (Inherent Package Integrity) 的概念非常重要：它指的是在沒有任何缺陷的情況下，包裝系統本身就能達到的完整性水準。這是設定 MALL 的基礎。
blocks.en: The concept of inherent package integrity is very important: it refers to the level of integrity a package system can achieve by itself when it has no defects. This is the basis for setting the MALL.

blocks.zh: USP 建議使用空瓶或安慰劑填充的容器進行大樣本量的固有完整性測試，以避免產品配方干擾測試方法。
blocks.en: USP recommends using empty vials or placebo-filled containers for inherent integrity testing with large sample sizes, to avoid interference from the product formulation with the test method.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 為何 MALL 的設定需要先於測試方法的選擇？
blocks.en: Why must the MALL be set before the test method is selected?

blocks.zh: 如果你負責一個凍乾產品的包裝開發，哪些環境條件必須納入產品-包裝概況？
blocks.en: If you are responsible for package development of a lyophilized product, which environmental conditions must be included in the product-package profile?

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析：組裝驗證的關鍵參數
blocks.en: Key Concepts: Critical Parameters for Package Assembly Validation

blocks.zh: 包裝組裝驗證必須覆蓋製程極端值，不能只測最佳條件。例如玻璃瓶軋蓋驗證必須包含：
blocks.en: Package assembly validation must cover process extremes, not just the optimal conditions. For example, validation of glass vial capping must include:

blocks.zh: 最低/最高軋蓋力 (vial-capping forces)
blocks.en: Minimum/maximum vial-capping forces

blocks.zh: 最低/最高線速 (line speed)
blocks.en: Minimum/maximum line speed

blocks.zh: 重新滅菌後的完整性
blocks.en: Integrity after re-sterilization

blocks.zh: 二次與三次包裝製程的影響
blocks.en: Effects of secondary and tertiary packaging processes

blocks.zh: 包裝組裝驗證就像汽車的碰撞測試：不只測試正常行駛，而是要在最惡劣的撞擊條件下（製程極端值）確認安全性（包裝完整性）。通過極端值測試，才能對日常生產的包裝有信心。
blocks.en: Package assembly validation is like a car crash test: it does not test only normal driving, but confirms safety (package integrity) under the harshest impact conditions (process extremes). Only by passing extreme-condition testing can you have confidence in the packages produced in routine manufacturing.

blocks.zh: USP 明確指出：製程內與成品的包裝完整性測試是「補充」而非「取代」充分的包裝開發工作。這與 FDA 的觀點一致——品質不是靠測試測出來的，而是設計進去的。
blocks.en: USP states explicitly that in-process and finished-product package integrity testing "supplements" rather than "replaces" adequate package development work. This is consistent with the FDA view: quality is not tested into a product, it is designed in.

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析：製造階段的品質策略
blocks.en: Key Concepts: Quality Strategy in the Manufacturing Stage

blocks.zh: 製造階段的 CCI 控制策略包含三個層次：
blocks.en: The CCI control strategy in the manufacturing stage has three layers:

blocks.zh: 供應商管理：進料品質的統計抽樣與驗收
blocks.en: Supplier management: statistical sampling and acceptance of incoming materials

blocks.zh: 製程監控：結合洩漏測試、密封品質測試、目視檢查
blocks.en: Process monitoring: combining leak testing, seal quality testing, and visual inspection

blocks.zh: 變更控制：任何產品、包裝設計或製程的變更都需重新評估 CCI
blocks.en: Change control: any change to the product, package design, or process requires CCI to be re-evaluated

blocks.zh: 重點提示：100% 非破壞性測試
blocks.en: Key Notes: 100% Nondestructive Testing

blocks.zh: 玻璃安瓿（熔封）是 100% 非破壞性洩漏測試的典型要求。這在法規上有依據——FDA 的無菌製造指引要求安瓿進行 100% 完整性測試。在 fill-finish 設施設計時，這是產線設備配置的重要考量。
blocks.en: Glass ampoules (fusion-sealed) are the classic case requiring 100% nondestructive leak testing. This has a regulatory basis: the FDA aseptic processing guidance requires 100% integrity testing of ampoules. When designing a fill-finish facility, this is an important consideration for line equipment configuration.

blocks.zh: 實務應用 Practical Application
blocks.en: Practical Application

blocks.zh: 在 CDMO 的 aseptic fill-finish 生產中，當客戶提出包裝材料的供應商替代時，必須評估 CCI 影響。USP〈1207.1〉第 2.2 節提供了清單：不只是供應商評估，還需要對新組件的進料品質進行統計評估，並更新 CAPA 程序。
blocks.en: In aseptic fill-finish manufacturing at a CDMO, when a client proposes replacing a packaging material supplier, the impact on CCI must be assessed. Section 2.2 of USP <1207.1> provides a checklist: beyond supplier evaluation, you also need to statistically evaluate the incoming quality of the new components and update the CAPA procedure.

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析：CCI 取代穩定性無菌試驗
blocks.en: Key Concepts: Replacing Stability Sterility Testing with CCI

blocks.zh: FDA 2008 年發布的指引允許以 CCI 測試替代穩定性方案中的無菌試驗。理由是：
blocks.en: The guidance FDA issued in 2008 allows CCI testing to replace sterility testing in the stability program. The reasons are:

blocks.zh: 無菌試驗樣本量太小，統計代表性不足
blocks.en: The sample size for sterility testing is too small to be statistically representative

blocks.zh: 無菌試驗只能偵測已經污染的樣本，無法預防性確保整個貨架期的完整性
blocks.en: Sterility testing can only detect samples that are already contaminated; it cannot proactively assure integrity throughout the shelf life

blocks.zh: CCI 測試（如真空衰減、雷射氣體分析）對微小洩漏更靈敏
blocks.en: CCI methods (such as vacuum decay and laser-based gas headspace analysis) are more sensitive to small leaks

blocks.zh: 穩定性無菌試驗就像每年只做一次血液檢查來確認自己有沒有生病——樣本量小、時間點有限。CCI 測試則像是持續監測體溫——更能反映整個儲存期間容器是否保持「密封無虞」的狀態。
blocks.en: Stability sterility testing is like having a blood test once a year to check whether you are ill: small sample, limited time points. CCI testing is more like continuously monitoring your body temperature: it better reflects whether the container stays sealed throughout the storage period.

blocks.zh: 非破壞性 CCI 測試通過的樣品可繼續用於當期穩定性測試，但不可在一個時間點（如 12 個月）測試後，再存放到下一個時間點（如 24 個月）使用。每個穩定性時間點必須有獨立的樣本組。
blocks.en: Samples that pass nondestructive CCI testing can continue to be used for the stability testing of the current time point, but must not be tested at one time point (e.g., 12 months) and then stored for use at the next time point (e.g., 24 months). Each stability time point must have an independent sample set.

blocks.zh: 為什麼 USP 明確指出 CCI 測試「不取代放行無菌試驗」？兩者的目的有何不同？
blocks.en: Why does USP state explicitly that CCI testing "does not replace" sterility testing for lot release? How do the purposes of the two differ?

blocks.zh: 如果某產品的 MALL 小於測試方法的偵測下限，在穩定性方案中應如何處理？
blocks.en: If a product's MALL is below the lower detection limit of the test method, how should this be handled in the stability program?

blocks.zh: Section 3 — Test Method Selection Criteria 測試方法選擇標準
blocks.en: Section 3 — Test Method Selection Criteria

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析：MALL 是方法選擇的核心
blocks.en: Key Concepts: The MALL Is the Core of Method Selection

blocks.zh: 最大允許洩漏限度 (MALL) 決定了你需要的測試靈敏度。簡單邏輯：
blocks.en: The maximum allowable leakage limit (MALL) determines the test sensitivity you need. The simple logic:

blocks.zh: MALL 越小（越嚴格）→ 需要更靈敏的測試方法（偵測限要更低）
blocks.en: Smaller (stricter) MALL → a more sensitive test method is needed (lower detection limit)

blocks.zh: 產品類別不同 → MALL 設定不同 → 方法選擇不同
blocks.en: Different product categories → different MALLs → different method choices

blocks.zh: 液態注射劑（需防菌入侵）vs. 凍乾劑（需保護真空頭空間）有根本上不同的需求
blocks.en: Liquid injectables (which must be protected against microbial ingress) and lyophilized products (which must protect the vacuum headspace) have fundamentally different needs

blocks.zh: 重點提示：材料相容性是第一道篩選
blocks.en: Key Notes: Material Compatibility Is the First Screen

blocks.zh: 在選方法之前，先問「這個方法與包裝材料相容嗎？」
blocks.en: Before choosing a method, first ask: "Is this method compatible with the packaging materials?"

blocks.zh: 塑料/彈性體 + 真空衰減 = 可能有 outgassing 干擾
blocks.en: Plastic/elastomer + vacuum decay = possible outgassing interference

blocks.zh: 鋁箔層壓 + HVLD = 不相容（鋁導電）
blocks.en: Aluminum foil laminate + HVLD = incompatible (aluminum is conductive)

blocks.zh: 不透明容器 + 雷射分析 = 不相容
blocks.en: Opaque container + laser analysis = incompatible

blocks.zh: 含溶液產品 + 壓力衰減 = 需注意液體覆蓋洩漏點
blocks.en: Liquid-containing product + pressure decay = watch for liquid covering the leak site

blocks.zh: 選擇 CCI 測試方法就像選擇醫學影像技術：X 光（快速便宜但限制多）、超音波（適合軟組織）、MRI（精細但昂貴慢）。沒有一種方法適用所有情況——必須根據「要找什麼、在哪裡找」來選擇。
blocks.en: Selecting a CCI test method is like selecting a medical imaging technique: X-ray (fast and cheap but with many limitations), ultrasound (suited to soft tissue), MRI (detailed but expensive and slow). No single method suits every situation; you must choose based on "what you are looking for and where you are looking".

blocks.zh: CDMO 接到新產品時的 CCI 方法選擇流程：(1) 確認產品類別（液態/凍乾/固態）→ (2) 確認容器材質（玻璃/塑料/鋁箔）→ (3) 確認頭空間需求 → (4) 查 MALL → (5) 比對各技術的偵測限（見〈1207.2〉Table 1）→ (6) 確認方法是否可上線或只能離線。
blocks.en: CDMO workflow for CCI method selection when receiving a new product: (1) confirm the product category (liquid/lyophilized/solid) → (2) confirm the container material (glass/plastic/aluminum foil) → (3) confirm headspace requirements → (4) check the MALL → (5) compare against the detection limits of each technology (see <1207.2> Table 1) → (6) confirm whether the method can be used on-line or only off-line.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：FDA/USP 的監管立場
blocks.en: Key Notes: FDA/USP Regulatory Position

blocks.zh: USP 明確表明：能偵測到 MALL 的確定性方法為首選。這與 FDA 2016 年後對 CCI 的監管趨勢一致——越來越多的 FDA 警告信點名企業使用機率性方法（如染料侵入法）而未進行充分驗證。
blocks.en: USP states explicitly that a deterministic method capable of detecting the MALL is preferred. This is consistent with the FDA's regulatory trend on CCI since 2016: a growing number of FDA warning letters have called out companies for using probabilistic methods (such as dye ingress) without adequate validation.

blocks.zh: 確定性方法像是數位體重計——每次測量值都一樣，可以精確記錄是否超重（超過 MALL）。機率性方法像是問路人「這個人看起來超重嗎？」——答案依賴觀察者判斷，樣本越多才越準確。
blocks.en: A deterministic method is like a digital bathroom scale: every measurement gives the same value, so you can record precisely whether someone is overweight (exceeds the MALL). A probabilistic method is like asking a passerby "does this person look overweight?": the answer depends on the observer's judgment, and it becomes more accurate only as the number of samples grows.

blocks.zh: 為什麼染料侵入試驗 (Dye Ingress Test) 被歸類為機率性方法？它的不確定性來源是什麼？
blocks.en: Why is the dye ingress test classified as a probabilistic method? What are the sources of its uncertainty?

blocks.zh: 你的客戶希望用泡泡放射測試 (Bubble Emission) 進行批次放行，請說明為何這在法規上有風險。
blocks.en: Your client wants to use the bubble emission test for lot release. Explain why this carries regulatory risk.

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析：確定性 vs. 機率性
blocks.en: Key Concepts: Deterministic vs. Probabilistic

blocks.zh: 這是 USP〈1207〉最重要的分類概念：
blocks.en: This is the most important classification concept in USP <1207>:

blocks.zh: 公式與計算 Formula — 洩漏率參考表的應用
blocks.en: Formula and Calculation: Applying the Leak Rate Reference Table

blocks.zh:
偵測下限對應表（參考用）：
Row 1 → 氦氣質譜法（真空模式）→ <0.1 µm
Row 2 → 追蹤氣體嗅探模式 → 0.1-1.0 µm
Row 3 → HVLD, 真空衰減, 質量萃取, 壓力衰減 → 1-5 µm
Row 4 → 泡泡放射, 微生物挑戰, 追蹤液體 → 5-10 µm
Row 6 → 目視檢查（大缺陷）→ >50 µm

實際驗證的偵測限可能偏離以上值
——必須針對特定產品-包裝系統建立
blocks.en:
Reference table of lower detection limits (for guidance only):
Row 1 → Helium mass spectrometry (vacuum mode) → <0.1 µm
Row 2 → Tracer gas sniffer mode → 0.1-1.0 µm
Row 3 → HVLD, vacuum decay, mass extraction, pressure decay → 1-5 µm
Row 4 → Bubble emission, microbial challenge, tracer liquid → 5-10 µm
Row 6 → Visual inspection (large defects) → >50 µm

The detection limit established in actual validation may deviate from the values above
— it must be established for the specific product-package system

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析：偵測限 vs. 偵測範圍
blocks.en: Key Concepts: Detection Limit vs. Detection Range

blocks.zh: 偵測限（Detection Limit）：方法能可靠偵測的最小洩漏。
blocks.en: Detection limit: the smallest leak the method can reliably detect.

blocks.zh: 偵測範圍（Detection Range）：方法的最小到最大偵測能力。注意：能偵測小洩漏的方法，不一定能偵測非常大的漏洞（如缺失組件）——可能需要視覺系統補充。
blocks.en: Detection range: the minimum to maximum detection capability of the method. Note: a method that can detect small leaks may not be able to detect very large breaches (such as a missing component), so a vision system may be needed as a supplement.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：On-line vs. Off-line 的取捨
blocks.en: Key Notes: On-line vs. Off-line Trade-offs

blocks.zh: On-line 測試的優點：100% 批次覆蓋、即時回饋。缺點：高線速→測試周期短→偵測靈敏度下降。Off-line 測試：只能抽樣，但靈敏度更高。這不是「哪個更好」，而是互補——填充線越複雜，越需要組合策略。
blocks.en: Advantages of on-line testing: 100% lot coverage and immediate feedback. Disadvantages: high line speed → short test cycle → reduced detection sensitivity. Off-line testing: sampling only, but higher sensitivity. This is not a question of "which is better" but of complementarity: the more complex the filling line, the more a combined strategy is needed.

blocks.zh: 在無菌灌裝線設計時，常見的組合策略：On-line HVLD（快速，Row 3 偵測）用於 100% 篩查 + Off-line 真空衰減（慢速，更靈敏）用於穩定性研究樣本。兩個方法互補，覆蓋從粗大缺陷到微小洩漏的完整範圍。
blocks.en: A common combined strategy in aseptic filling line design: on-line HVLD (fast, Row 3 detection) for 100% screening + off-line vacuum decay (slower, more sensitive) for stability study samples. The two methods complement each other and cover the full range from gross defects to very small leaks.

blocks.zh: Section 4 — Test Instrument Qualification, Method Development, and Method Validation 測試儀器資格確認、方法開發與方法驗證
blocks.en: Section 4 — Test Instrument Qualification, Method Development, and Method Validation

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析：CCI 方法驗證的八要素
blocks.en: Key Concepts: The Eight Elements of CCI Method Validation

blocks.zh: 對應 ICH Q2(R1) 分析方法驗證，CCI 方法驗證的八個要素：
blocks.en: Aligned with ICH Q2(R1) analytical method validation, the eight elements of CCI method validation are:

blocks.zh: 準確性 (Accuracy)：正確區分洩漏/不洩漏的能力 → 衡量假陽性與假陰性率
blocks.en: Accuracy: the ability to correctly distinguish leaking from non-leaking units → measured by the false positive and false negative rates

blocks.zh: 精密性 (Precision)：重複測試的一致性（含重複性、中間精密性、再現性）
blocks.en: Precision: consistency of repeated tests (including repeatability, intermediate precision, and reproducibility)

blocks.zh: 專一性 (Specificity)：排除干擾因素的能力
blocks.en: Specificity: the ability to exclude interfering factors

blocks.zh: 偵測限 (Detection Limit)：最小可偵測洩漏
blocks.en: Detection limit: the smallest detectable leak

blocks.zh: 定量限 (Quantitation Limit)：最小可定量洩漏速率
blocks.en: Quantitation limit: the smallest leak rate that can be quantified

blocks.zh: 線性 (Linearity)：結果與洩漏大小成正比的能力
blocks.en: Linearity: the ability of the result to be proportional to leak size

blocks.zh: 範圍 (Range)：偵測範圍的上下邊界
blocks.en: Range: the upper and lower boundaries of the detection range

blocks.zh: 穩健性 (Robustness)：方法在小偏差下仍可靠的能力
blocks.en: Robustness: the ability of the method to remain reliable under small deviations

blocks.zh: CCI 方法驗證就像校準一把尺：準確性 = 這把尺量出來的 10cm 是真的 10cm；精密性 = 同一個人量三次都一樣；專一性 = 溫度變化不會讓尺變長；偵測限 = 這把尺能分辨到 0.1mm 還是 1mm？每個要素都是確保測量可靠性的一塊拼圖。
blocks.en: CCI method validation is like calibrating a ruler: accuracy = the 10 cm this ruler shows is truly 10 cm; precision = the same person measuring three times gets the same result; specificity = temperature changes do not make the ruler stretch; detection limit = can this ruler resolve 0.1 mm or only 1 mm? Each element is a piece of the puzzle that ensures reliable measurement.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：假陰性比假陽性更危險
blocks.en: Key Notes: False Negatives Are More Dangerous Than False Positives

blocks.zh: 在 CCI 驗證中，假陰性（漏掉洩漏）的風險遠高於假陽性（錯判洩漏）。FDA 的 CCI 相關警告信中，最常見的批評是方法無法可靠地偵測到接近 MALL 的小洩漏。驗證時應重點確保：在 MALL 附近的缺陷被偵測的概率達到可接受水準（通常 ≥ 95%）。
blocks.en: In CCI validation, the risk of a false negative (missing a leak) is far greater than that of a false positive (wrongly calling a leak). The most common criticism in FDA warning letters related to CCI is that the method cannot reliably detect small leaks near the MALL. Validation should focus on ensuring that the probability of detecting defects near the MALL reaches an acceptable level (typically ≥ 95%).

blocks.zh: 如何在 CCI 驗證方案中設計「穩健性 (Robustness)」研究？以真空衰減法為例，列出三個需要測試的方法參數偏差。
blocks.en: How would you design a robustness study in a CCI validation protocol? Using vacuum decay as an example, list three method parameter deviations that should be tested.

blocks.zh: 氦氣示蹤氣體法的專一性問題是什麼？如何在驗證中評估此干擾？
blocks.en: What is the specificity issue with the helium tracer gas method? How would you evaluate this interference during validation?

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析：陽性對照品設計的層次
blocks.en: Key Concepts: Tiers of Positive Control Design

blocks.zh: USP 要求陽性對照品必須覆蓋完整的偵測範圍：
blocks.en: USP requires positive controls to cover the full detection range:

blocks.zh: 第一層：接近偵測限的小缺陷（最關鍵）→ 確認方法在邊界能否偵測
blocks.en: Tier 1: small defects near the detection limit (most critical) → confirm whether the method can detect at the boundary

blocks.zh: 第二層：括弧式缺陷（稍大和稍小於偵測限）→ 建立偵測機率曲線
blocks.en: Tier 2: bracketing defects (slightly larger and slightly smaller than the detection limit) → establish the probability-of-detection curve

blocks.zh: 第三層：大缺陷（確認方法上限）→ 確保大缺陷不會「miss」
blocks.en: Tier 3: large defects (confirm the upper limit of the method) → ensure large defects are not missed

blocks.zh: 類型缺陷 (Type Defects)：模擬真實生產中可能出現的缺陷型態
blocks.en: Type defects: defect forms that simulate those that may occur in real production

blocks.zh: 重點提示：激光鑽孔的局限性
blocks.en: Key Notes: Limitations of Laser Drilling

blocks.zh: 激光鑽出的「孔洞」並非完美的圓形小孔，而是非對稱的微裂紋矩陣。因此：
blocks.en: The "holes" produced by laser drilling are not perfectly round small orifices but asymmetric microcrack matrices. Therefore:

blocks.zh: 不能直接用幾何公式計算洩漏率
blocks.en: Leak rate cannot be calculated directly from geometric formulas

blocks.zh: 需要通過「與標準孔板的氣體洩漏率比較」來定名直徑
blocks.en: The nominal diameter must be assigned by comparing the gas leak rate against a standard orifice

blocks.zh: 優點是接近真實缺陷形態（如裂縫）
blocks.en: The advantage is that they closely resemble real defect morphology (such as cracks)

blocks.zh: 系統適用性 (System Suitability) 就像每天早上上班前校準辦公室的體重計。在開始一批測試之前，先用已知的陰性/陽性對照品確認儀器今天是否正常運作——這是保障每批測試數據可信度的例行動作。
blocks.en: System suitability is like calibrating the office scale every morning before work. Before starting a test run, use known negative/positive controls to confirm that the instrument is operating properly today. This is a routine step that safeguards the reliability of the data from every test run.

blocks.zh: 在 aseptic vial filling 的 CCI 驗證中，類型缺陷 (Type Defects) 的設計應包含：(1) 瓶口通道缺陷（模擬瓶口缺角）→ 最常見的真實生產缺陷；(2) 膠塞未完全插入（loosely capped stopper）→ 模擬軋蓋失敗；(3) 產品夾在膠塞與瓶口之間（product trapped）→ 模擬灌裝過量。這三類缺陷若無法被選定的 CCI 方法偵測，需要補充其他監控措施。
blocks.en: For CCI validation in aseptic vial filling, the design of type defects should include: (1) finish channel defects (simulating a chipped vial finish) → the most common real production defect; (2) stopper not fully seated (loosely capped stopper) → simulating a capping failure; (3) product trapped between the stopper and the vial finish (product trapped) → simulating overfilling. If the selected CCI method cannot detect these three types of defects, additional monitoring measures are needed.

blocks.zh: 本章重點回顧 Chapter Summary
blocks.en: Chapter Summary

blocks.zh: 三階段生命週期：CCI 測試涵蓋開發/驗證、製造、商業穩定性三個階段，各有不同目標與方法要求
blocks.en: Three-stage life cycle: CCI testing spans three stages: development/validation, manufacturing, and commercial stability, each with different objectives and method requirements

blocks.zh: MALL 是核心：最大允許洩漏限度定義了測試方法必須達到的靈敏度門檻
blocks.en: MALL is the core: the maximum allowable leakage limit defines the sensitivity threshold the test method must achieve

blocks.zh: 確定性方法優先：能達到 MALL 的確定性方法為 FDA/USP 首選；機率性方法在確定性方法不適用時才考慮
blocks.en: Deterministic methods first: a deterministic method that can reach the MALL is preferred by FDA/USP; probabilistic methods are considered only when deterministic methods are not applicable

blocks.zh: 12 項選擇標準：包裝內容物、設計材質、密封類型、MALL、確定性/機率性、理化/微生物學、結果類型、定量/定性、偵測限、偵測範圍、破壞性/非破壞性、離線/在線
blocks.en: 12 selection criteria: package contents, design and materials, seal type, MALL, deterministic/probabilistic, physicochemical/microbiological, result type, quantitative/qualitative, detection limit, detection range, destructive/nondestructive, off-line/on-line

blocks.zh: 八要素驗證：準確性（偽陽/偽陰）、精密性（三層次）、專一性、偵測限、定量限、線性、範圍、穩健性
blocks.en: Eight-element validation: accuracy (false positives/negatives), precision (three levels), specificity, detection limit, quantitation limit, linearity, range, robustness

blocks.zh: 對照品設計：陰性對照品（完好包裝）+ 陽性對照品（已知缺陷，需涵蓋偵測限附近的括弧式範圍）+ 類型缺陷（真實生產場景）
blocks.en: Control design: negative controls (intact packages) + positive controls (known defects, covering a bracketing range around the detection limit) + type defects (real production scenarios)

blocks.zh: 法規要點：CCI 測試可取代穩定性方案中的無菌試驗（FDA 2008），但不取代批次放行無菌試驗
blocks.en: Regulatory points: CCI testing can replace sterility testing in the stability program (FDA 2008), but does not replace lot release sterility testing
